headline: West Liberty alone still winning every match
dek: West Liberty have won all four of their matches and are the only programme yet to drop a point. Frostburg State and Davis & Elkins are also unbeaten, but have three draws between them. The other seven programmes have nineteen defeats between them, and West Virginia Wesleyan and Wheeling account for nine of those.
displaced_by: West Liberty conceded at Wheeling on 13 Sep, so the unbeaten trio no longer have four goals against apiece; West Liberty are now the only side with a perfect record

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Charleston's fourteen goals have come from nine different scorers, and no one of them has more than three; the scoring is spread, not carried.

wire.line: Every programme has now conceded, and only West Virginia Wesleyan are still without a win.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: West Liberty have won all four of their matches, and three of the four were won by a single goal.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Anthony Fusay has two shutouts for Point Park, and no other keeper on the list has any.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: West Virginia Wesleyan have lost all five of their matches, three of them to conference opponents, and have scored three goals while conceding thirteen.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Shawnee State have scored twelve goals and conceded fifteen; six of the twelve came in a single match.

findings.label: signal
findings.text: Leyton Collier's fourteen shots have produced three goals for West Liberty; no other player on the leaders list has taken more than ten.

last_match.line: West Liberty are still the only side to have won every match; Wheeling have lost every conference match they have played.

next_match.line: Frostburg State have yet to lose at home; West Liberty have yet to drop a point anywhere.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
